newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-CORK BACK INJURY COULD FORCE HIM OUT OF FIRST TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-CORK BACK INJURY COULD FORCE HIM OUT OF FIRST TEST.

text.p: England strike bowler Dominic Cork may miss the first test against New Zealand after injuring his back in the match against Northern Districts on Sunday.
Cork left the field after bowling nine overs, complaining of a stabbing pain in the right side of his back.
The first match of the three-test series starts in Auckland on Thursday.
England physio Wayne Morton said: "It will be 24 or 48 hours before we know the full extent of his injury.''
Morton gave Cork manipulative treatment, an injection and massaged the affected area. He then sent him back to the team hotel wearing a protective corset.
